name: equal-conclusions-reuse-review
invariant: Equal conclusions reuse a review, and a change re-runs it: a review that ran on its gate's first result stands when the gate's next selected result, after an invalidation, has an unchanged conclusions digest, subject, instrument, project and restrictions (empty/conclusions_unchanged); a changed step outcome or changed restrictions on its receipt Ref re-run it (found/review_input_changed) (13 "Reuse decisions use typed conclusions"; 11:167).
